name: They read a lot.
He likes ice cream.
I work in a shop.
My brother works in a bank.
trans: 我哥哥在一家银行工作。

name: Lucy lives in London, Her parents live in Scotland.
trans: 露西住在伦敦，她的父母住在苏格兰。

name: It rains a lot in winter.
Joe has a shower every day.
I like big cities.
Your English is good.
You speak very well.
Tom works very hard.
He starts at 7:30 and finishes at 8 o'clock in the evening.
trans: 他早上7点半开始工作，晚上8点结束。

name: The earth goes round the sun.
We do a lot of different things in our free time.
trans: 我们在空闲时间做很多不同的事情。

name: It costs a lot of money to build a hospital.
trans: 建一所医院要花很多钱。

name: Sue always gets to work early.
I never eat breakfast.
We often go away at weekends.
Mark usually plays football on Sundays.
trans: 马克通常在星期天踢足球。

name: I sometimes walk to work but not very often.
trans: 我有时步行去上班，但并不常。
